text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before summer training camp,
seeing Copano 
Rickey run made Hokko Tarumae feel that 
something was different than before. With 
someone chasing right behind her, she too 
gets fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined not to lose to Copano Rickey, 
Hokko Tarumae burned with fighting
spirit. 
A scorching-hot training camp was about
to begin—!
